resources.string: Pair your first Nostr account to get started with scheduling posts.

This account was paired before private messaging existed, so its signer has not granted permission to encrypt, seal or decrypt messages. Re-pairing keeps your posts and settings.
Your signer refused a message operation for this account. Re-pair and choose Always when it asks about decrypting messages.

Profile data is fetched from Nostr relays. Change it with \"Nostr profile\" on the account page, or use \"Refresh profile\" to update it here.

Square. Shown as a circle in most clients.

Approve the connection in Amber or another NIP-46 signer to pair this Nostr account.
The key stays in your signer. Emanator only ever receives events you have already approved.
Don\'t have a Nostr account yet?

Create one in your signer app, then pair it here. In Amber, choose \"Generate a new key\" and back it up when it asks. Once it is paired you can set its name, bio and pictures from Nostr profile in the account\'s settings.
Private messages need permissions your signer has not granted yet — encrypting, sealing and decrypting messages. Re-pair to request them. Your posts and settings will be preserved.
Re-pair the signer, for example on a new relay. Your posts and settings will be preserved.
On the first \"decrypt\" prompt, choose Always and scope All. Otherwise every single message needs a tap on your phone.

When Amber asks about relay authentication, choose scope All relays. If you use Amber\'s Client auth whitelist, add your DM inbox relays to it — while that list is non-empty Amber rejects every other relay without asking.
Account paired! Fetching profile and relay list in the background.
